headline: Standard Chartered Bank Kenya Nine-Month Profit Rises 7.4% to KSh 10.5 Billion
summary: Standard Chartered Bank Kenya posted a 7.39% increase in net profit for the first nine months of 2026 to KSh 10.51 billion, bolstered by growth in non-funded income despite lower overall top-line revenue.
why: StanChart Kenya is among the top tier-one commercial lenders listed in Nairobi, heavily focused on corporate and institutional banking.

impacts.name: Standard Chartered Bank Kenya
impacts.why: Profitability gains driven by fee and commission income support full-year dividend expectations.
